response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his work with DLang and Node.js doesn't fully align with the core tech stack required for routing tiling.
strengths: Proven geospatial project experience with GISCollective and Open Green Map
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and learn new languages
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement in developer tooling
concerns: No visible commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing, navigation, or geospatial data pipelines
Primary recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, not low-latency systems or distributed map tile generation
Limited evidence of expertise in fault tolerance, consistency, or real-time traffic integration for routing systems
